request.learnerQuestion: Why are the outcomes random but still linked?

tutorResponse.summary: The Hadamard gate made qubit 0 uncertain; the CNOT then tied qubit 1 to that branch. Each shot is random, but the pair is correlated.

steps.title: After CNOT
steps.body: The verified support moves to 00 = 0.5 and 11 = 0.5.
